purpose: Inventions and inventors through prior art, dated prototypes, patent claims, collaborators, testing, production, adoption, and service life.
editorial_principles: Use a named jurisdiction, population, and date where applicable.
Present comparisons on equal terms and label illustrative scenarios.
Verify primary sources and current guidance before production.
Name invention version, claimed function, jurisdiction, and date. Distinguish patent, working prototype, commercial adoption, and sole-inventor mythology; avoid hazardous replication instructions.
